raw.title: Antoine Arnauld
raw.description: French Catholic theologian, philosopher and mathematician (1612–1694)
raw.extract: Antoine Arnauld was a French Catholic theologian, priest, philosopher and mathematician. He was one of the leading intellectuals of the Jansenist group of Port-Royal and had a very thorough knowledge of patristics. Contemporaries called him le Grand to distinguish him from his father.
